high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a balcony with a scenic view of a cityscape and mountains in the background. The individual is wearing a flowing, light pink dress with a layered, ruffled skirt that extends to mid-calf length. The dress has a sheer, open-back design with wide sleeves that drape elegantly. The person is also wearing brown knee-high boots. The setting appears to be a modern building with large glass windows or doors, allowing for an unobstructed view of the landscape outside.
